name: Shinobi Alliance Kiba (S)
description: Now in the war, Kiba is one of the most powerful close-range combatants. Utilizing the vast arsenal of the Inuzuka clan, Kiba can combat even colossal enemies with Akamaru and their tornado fang.
unlock: Mission: The Boy and His Dog At War

skills.name: Tornado Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 30 piercing damage to one enemy and makes them deal 10 less non-affliction damage for 1 turn. During 'Three Headed Wolf', this skill will deal 10 additional damage.

skills.name: Three Headed Wolf
skills.description: Kiba removes all harmful physical and mental skills from his team and, for 3 turns, targets all enemies. During this time, enemies that use a new harmful skill will take 5 piercing damage and permanently receive 5 additional damage from physical skills. This skill is replaced by 'Tail Rotating Fang' and ends when Kiba dies.

skills.name: Man Animal Tatics
skills.description: Kiba and one ally will deal 5 additional damage with non-affliction skills for 2 turns. During this time, every time a new enemy harmful skill is used on them, their skills will cost 1 less random chakra for 1 turn.

skills.name: Kiba Block
skills.description: This skill makes Shinobi War Kiba (S) invulnerable for 1 turn.

skills.name: Tail Rotating Fang
skills.description: Kiba deals 45 piercing damage to one enemy and becomes invulnerable for 1 turn. Permanently, both Kiba and that enemy will deal 5 less non-affliction damage.
